title: Operator inbox: skip harness task notifications at capture
body: Defect found 2026-11-07 by the lead: the UserPromptSubmit capture (scripts/claude/operator-inbox.ts, #260) records harness-injected <task-notification> blocks from background agents as operator prompts; one lead session collected ~20 such entries, so the handoff check blocked on noise. Skip prompts that start with <task-notification> (and other harness-injected wrappers such as <system-reminder>) at capture; test with a captured notification payload.
